title: Relay cost and funding decision
scope: Relay B1 cumulative cost position before CR-001

baseline.reserve_control: Sponsor-controlled outside the B1 performance baseline

performance.earning_rule: Discrete completed deliverables and evidenced weighted milestones
performance.source: Fictional cumulative performance report through 16 October

categories.label: Internal delivery labor
categories.source: Ledger L-16 and bottom-up estimate E-9
categories.note: The remaining estimate includes correction and acceptance work.

categories.label: Vendor services
categories.note: The 8 incurred is not repeated in the 12 unspent.

categories.label: Platform and tooling
categories.note: Taxes and the accounting boundary follow the supplied fictional case.

funding_options.label: Release original management reserve
funding_options.effect: Raises accessible funding only with the recorded release; does not erase cost variance.

funding_options.label: Authorize additional funding
funding_options.amount: 10 k USD beyond the original envelope
funding_options.basis: Needed if the 120 k USD scenario is accepted after ETC review
funding_options.effect: Would close the remaining funding gap without retroactively changing the 16 October B1 report.

funding_options.label: Defer optional dashboard polish
funding_options.basis: Optional scope only; security acceptance remains mandatory
funding_options.effect: May reduce remaining cost and affect the selected EAC.

presentation.headline: A 120k forecast is still 10k beyond the envelope
presentation.lede: Compare performance, current remaining work and funding authority without treating reserve as automatic permission.
presentation.insight_heading: Forecast and authority are different controls
insight_points: The original reserve closes only half of that gap.
presentation.decision: Reconcile the current ETC and obligations, then obtain an explicit reserve release plus additional funding or a supported scope decision.

analysis.method: Cumulative EVM scenarios plus actual-and-remaining cost reconciliation at one status date.
analysis.accounting_boundary: Actuals, unspent commitments and other ETC are separate; category actuals reconcile to AC.
analysis.authorization_boundary: The 120 k USD scenario does not release reserve or authorize spending. CR-001 occurs after this snapshot.

notes: Fictional instructional data; amounts are thousands of USD.
